text: {"frames":["A smell of wet reeds and tar came through the fog before the sound did. Then the bell of the drowned village began to toll, slow and low, from somewhere under the canal. Femke leaned over the rail and counted the strokes against the old tune her grandmother hummed. The bell had rung only {x} of the strokes it owed the fishermen. The fishermen want it finished before the fog lifts, so what is {x} as a percentage?","Nobody had ever seen the watchman of the dyke by daylight, but his lantern was lit at the lock this morning. Joop found the wooden gate open and a row of clogs set neatly on the sill. Someone had chalked a mark for every stretch of the dyke, and only {x} of the marks had been crossed out. The watchman leaves a mark for each stretch he has checked, so the rest is still waiting. What is {x} as a percentage of the whole dyke, in whole percent?","Hello? Is anyone there? Thijs called at the house with the hoist beam, where every window glowed yellow. Nobody answered, but a kettle was warm on the stove and waffles stood cooling on the table. Pinned to the wall was a list, and someone had crossed off {x} of the names on it. The lamps will go out for good once the list is finished, so what is {x} as a percentage?","Lot pulled the winding rope of the tower clock, and the bell struck an hour that is not on the dial. The little door below the face swung open on its own. Inside, the pendulum swung over a strip of paper, and someone had shaded {x} of it while the rest stayed blank. The clock will give the lost hour back only when the shaded part is known, so what is {x} as a percentage?","Help me, please, a voice said from the open book on the reading desk. The words kept writing themselves, line after line, about the mill on the third floor. The last page says the mill has turned {x} of its sails, and the rest are still tangled in the threads. What is {x} as a percentage, so the book knows how far the mill has gone?"]}
